jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
jobs.description:
Company Description
GARUNA SOFTWARE is a web development and digital solutions company dedicated to helping businesses build a strong and professional online presence. The team designs and develops modern, responsive websites, web applications, e-commerce platforms, and tailored digital experiences. Solutions are customized to meet specific business needs, ensuring usability and scalability. GARUNA SOFTWARE focuses on reliability and performance to support sustainable business growth. Applicants can expect to work in a dynamic environment that values practical, results-oriented digital products.
Role Description
This remote Full Stack Developer Intern role involves contributing to the design, development, and maintenance of web applications. Day-to-day tasks include implementing front-end interfaces, integrating back-end services, fixing bugs, and optimizing application performance under the guidance of senior developers. The intern will participate in code reviews, collaborate with the team through online tools, and help test new features to ensure quality and responsiveness. This internship offers hands-on experience with modern web technologies and real client projects, providing a foundation for professional growth in full stack development.
Qualifications

Foundational knowledge of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with an understanding of responsive design principles.
Basic experience with back-end development using at least one server-side language or framework (e.g., Node.js, Python, PHP, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs.
Understanding of databases (SQL or NoSQL), including basic querying and data modeling concepts.
Familiarity with version control tools like Git and collaborative development workflows.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to learn new technologies quickly.
Effective remote communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as in a distributed team.
Enrollment in or completion of a degree or training program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required.
Interest in web development, digital solutions, and building user-focused products that support business growth.
